verdict.rationale: IRCC publishes at least one exact filing deadline: Start-up Visa applicants must apply by June 30, 2026 with a valid 2025 commitment certificate, after which the program is closed. That is the only dated deadline in the evidence, and nothing shows a penalty or interest schedule for missing it beyond the program closing. Missing for 10: a published schedule of deadlines across founder-relevant filings, an exact-figure penalty and interest schedule for late or missed filings, and independent corroboration.
